label: batch-6
tail:
Batch 6 was already scaffolded by an earlier Beta-6 dispatch that stopped before writing its proof contract. I wrote the missing contract, and doing so exposed four defects in the earlier pass's own manifest, which I corrected.

## Report to the step-3 Alpha

**Artifact completed.** `research/frontier-18-batch-6.proof-contracts.json` — version 1, 50 scoped items (the A page's 44 less 9 definitions and 1 remark, plus all 16 B items), 464 citations, 312 numbered-step entries, 400 boundary rows (8 per item, none templated), `finite_smoke: []` throughout, no `risk_review`.

**Contract quality, checked mechanically.** All 326 citations naming an item already on disk quote text that really occurs in that item's named section, verified with the repo's own `tools/facts-block.mjs` under `proof-contract.mjs`'s normalisation. The other 138 quote items this pair will author and are planned text, flagged as such. Every fact label is inside the `[FAL]\d+` grammar; `uses` and step `inputs` were generated from one source so they cannot disagree; every step is claimed exactly once; every `checked` boundary row anchors to a real step.

**Four manifest corrections, applied (findings 13–16 in the notes).**
1. `ex-the-planar-divergence-theorem-on-a-rectangle` — the strategy's edge values summed to 1/2 against its own area integral of 3/2. The top edge gives +1/2, not −1/2.
2. `ex-a-u-shaped-prism-as-a-finite-gluing-of-three-boxes` — the bar's `y=1` face is larger than either upright's, so the "two full rectangular faces" the strategy claimed do not exist. It must be cut at `x=1` and `x=2` into three patches before any pairing is possible.
3. `fs-stokes-needs-the-surface-to-be-a-graph` — the boundary chain was stated backwards (bottom circle forward, top reversed, by the published positive-boundary rule), and no field was named; the obvious candidate makes both sides zero. Now `F=(-yz,xz,0)`, both sides `-2π`.
4. Four dependency-list entries (three distinct ids) that two proofs need were undeclared: `def-determinant-of-a-square-matrix` for the 2×2 Jacobian expansion, and `thm-cross-product-norm-is-the-two-vector-gram-determinant`, `def-determinant-of-a-square-matrix`, `lem-standard-basis-of-f-n` for the normal-curl corollary. That corollary's "orthonormal basis extension" was reachable only through `thm-every-independent-set-extends-to-a-basis`, which **assumes AC** for a statement about ℝ³; the contract replaces it with an explicit choice-free construction.

**Two further findings, no manifest edit.** `lem-content-zero-implies-null` is about ℝ only — citing it for the ℝᵐ implication would be the inaccurate-citation defect; the contract routes that through `def-null-and-content-zero-in-rn`. And two other batches' contracts will not validate: batch 7 uses fact labels `P#/T#/E#/C#/X#` that `facts-block.mjs` cannot parse, and batch 5 carries zero citation entries across all 96 of its scoped items. Neither is mine to fix.

**Gates run.** `content-policy --manifest-only` 60 items, 0/0. `coverage-checklist` 92 harvested results, 0/0. `source-fetch-check` 3/3 verified. `merge-proof-contracts` across the run: 381 items from 7 batch contracts, no `duplicate-item`. Dependency classification recomputed after the edits: 369 disk-earlier, 99 same-page-earlier, 45 batch-earlier, zero later/homeless/unresolved.

**Not verified.** `proof-contract`, `finite-smoke` and `risk-report` all report `item-missing` on all 50 — the correct step-2 state, and the same shape batch 7 reports. `validate-plan` and `depsource` were not run; my classification is a reimplementation, not the gate. I read the coverage harvest but did not re-check it against the three sources.
